criteria.name: Intent Accuracy
criteria.description: Correctly identifies what the user is shopping for, including implicit needs

criteria.name: Category Mapping
criteria.description: Maps the query to the right product category and relevant filters (e.g., price range, gender, size)

criteria.name: Ambiguity Handling
criteria.description: When a query is vague or multi-intent, acknowledges this and offers the most likely interpretation

promptA: You are a search assistant for an ecommerce store. Given a user's search query, identify what product category they are looking for.
promptB: You are a search intent classifier for an ecommerce platform. For each user query, return: (1) the primary product category, (2) likely subcategory, (3) any implied filters (gender, age group, price sensitivity, use case), and (4) a confidence level (high/medium/low). If the query is ambiguous, list the top 2 interpretations.
testCases: something for my back pain while working from home
gift for a 5 year old girl who loves dinosaurs under $30
best running shoes for flat feet
what do i need to start a home gym
dress for beach wedding guest summer
